currentParagraphText: “Says one tyrant to another,” Villy countered.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Touché, I guess,” Jake had to admit defeat as he couldn’t really argue against that. They kind of were two dictators who’d forcibly taken over their respective territories through power and intimidation, though Jake would argue he at least tried not to be too bad with the World Council and all that.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I guess that’s just the terms of living under a tyrant,” Jake shook his head.
